Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our top options to compare are Fika (from our Icons collection) and High Five (from our Rebels collection):
• Fika ($10.39/sq ft): A wide-plank (7 ⅜") traditional engineered European white oak floor. It features a sandable 1/8" wear layer, a matte finish, and a soft blonde tone. It's built to last for generations with classic Scandinavian elegance.
• High Five ($5.59/sq ft): A 6" wide real wood floor built with hardened wood construction. It is 100% waterproof for up to 24 hours, highly dent-resistant, and 3–5x stronger than traditional hardwood.
Which is better for you? If you prioritize maximum durability, pet/kid mess resistance, and a budget-friendly price, High Five is the winner. If you prefer long wide planks, classic elegance, and the ability to sand/refinish your floors down the road, go with Fika!
